title: Add a drawer About component showing open-source licenses
scope: Backlog intake only; implementation is deferred until selected.
sequencing: Prerequisite satisfied on 2026-11-04: user accepted UX-004's decision to retain Font Awesome and requested closure. About uses the existing Font Awesome font inventory; no icon migration is required. UI-012 itself remains unimplemented.
request: Add an About component to the drawer where users can view the open-source licenses used by QShopper.
expected: Users can open About from the drawer, identify the included open-source components and read their license texts and attribution notices.
implementation_notes: Inventory the actual shipped libraries, fonts, icons and other third-party assets; obtain license texts and attribution details from the corresponding bundled or upstream sources rather than guessing.
Bundle the license information so it is available offline. Identify each component and its applicable license; include relevant copyright and attribution notices.
Keep the presentation KISS, readable, scrollable and consistent with the app theme, safe areas and touch sizing. Choose the concrete About presentation when implementing.
Keep opening and closing About from disrupting the shopping list, checked state, editor position or unfinished text.
Coordinate the component inventory with REL-001's release licensing review; this feature alone does not establish release readiness.

DEV-011 adds Qt Canvas Painter / QtCanvas2D. The installed module and official documentation identify commercial or GPL-3.0-only licensing; include its actual bundled license and notices in the shipped dependency inventory. See https://doc.qt.io/qt-6/qtcanvaspainter-index.html.
acceptance_criteria: The drawer provides an accessible About component or entry that exposes the open-source license information.
The displayed inventory matches the dependencies and third-party assets actually shipped in the app, with identifiable components, license texts and attribution notices.
License information remains available without a network connection, and long texts can be scrolled to the end within the safe area.
Closing About, including through Android Back, preserves the list and unfinished editing state.
Add automated UI coverage for opening About from the drawer, reading/scrolling the license content and returning without changing app data. Verify Android presentation and Back behavior.
evidence: User backlog request on 2026-10-30 to add a drawer About component for viewing the open-source licenses used.

ui023_payload_observation.finding: Fresh UI-023 Android packages still contain Canvas2D and CanvasPainter libraries despite removal of explicit QML/module/link usage. Inventory the actual APK; the deployment dependency/scan path has not been established. No packaging change is included in UI-023.

dev008_inventory_update.finding: DEV-008 removes Canvas/VirtualKeyboard/test/Widgets/unused-style and plugin payload from fresh packages through source isolation, explicit imports and Qt plugin deployment. Inventory the final retained APK libraries/assets; keep historical UI-023 observations as history, not current shipped dependencies.
dev008_inventory_update.reports: out/dev008/final-arm64-package.json and final-x86-package.json contain final runtime libraries/ELF dependencies. Default and Release packages exclude QML tooling; developer opt-in packages have a separate inventory.
